description: A union `{ ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: E }` that puts expected failures in the return type.
A literal property (`ok: true` / `ok: false`) whose check narrows a union to one member.
`Result<T, never>` is assignable to `Result<T, E>` for every `E`, which makes `ok()` reusable.
Validation and not-found cases are values; bugs and infrastructure crashes stay exceptions.
